polaris: exact O_s is not a bare reported scalar but a provenance-conditioned observable; define a proof-carrying baseline contract.

framework.name: proof-carrying observable identity
framework.cross_domain_jump: software supply-chain provenance + proof-carrying execution + finite-state runtime admission
framework.core_translation: Treat an O_s value like an executable artifact: it is admissible only when the value is accompanied by a minimal proof object binding source row/page, structure identity, pair enumeration, raw overlap sum, normalization rule, same-structure mapping, and executor trace.
framework.baseline_contract: A baseline may report context, attempt reproduction, or certify exact O_s only by selecting an admissible mode and satisfying that mode's proof obligations.

cross_domain_sources.title: Proof-Carrying Code with Untrusted Proof Rules
cross_domain_sources.authors: George C. Necula; Robert R. Schneck
cross_domain_sources.role_in_framework: A computed artifact can carry checkable evidence that the consumer verifies before trusting execution or output.

cross_domain_sources.title: Proof-Carrying Hardware: Towards Runtime Verification of Reconfigurable Modules
cross_domain_sources.authors: Stephanie Drzevitzky; Uwe Kastens; Marco Platzner
cross_domain_sources.role_in_framework: Admission can be runtime-gated by formal proof obligations rather than by post hoc trust in a module.

cross_domain_sources.title: The rationale of PROV
cross_domain_sources.authors: Luc Moreau; Paul Groth; James Cheney; Timothy Lebo; Simon Miles
cross_domain_sources.role_in_framework: Provenance entities, activities, and agents provide the natural schema for binding an observable value to its generating chain.

cross_domain_sources.title: Reproducibility of scientific workflows execution using cloud-aware provenance (ReCAP)
cross_domain_sources.role_in_framework: Reproducibility requires execution-environment provenance, not only data and code names.

cross_domain_sources.title: Verifiable Provenance of Software Artifacts with Zero-Knowledge Compilation
cross_domain_sources.role_in_framework: Artifact provenance can be formulated as a cryptographically checkable relation between declared input, executor, and output.

math_object.not_bare_scalar: The scalar value is only one projection pi_value(O_s). Exactness is a predicate over the full tuple, not over pi_value alone.
math_object.admission_predicate: admit(mode, O_s_claim) = true iff required(mode) subset proof_objects(O_s_claim) and every equality/checksum/cardinality/normalization check passes.
math_object.transition_rule: A claim can move from S_i to S_{i+1} only by adding the missing proof object for the next gate; numeric closeness alone is not a transition witness.

findings.finding: The baseline contract should classify Srivastava-style overlap information as reported context unless it carries row/page and execution-proof objects.
The current exact O_s reproduction is blocked by absent provenance objects, not by a demonstrated physical contradiction.
The key observable is not O_s_value but O_s_identity. Two equal scalars with different structure hashes, pair lists, or normalizers are different observables.
A proof-carrying baseline can be finite-state: each mode has explicit pass/block conditions, so future work cannot silently slide from context to exact reproduction.

objects.R: source row/page locator for the reported O_s or its ingredients
objects.P: pair cutoff policy plus pair list or deterministic enumerator hash
objects.Z: normalization formula or executable code hash
objects.M: same-structure mapping between source structure and reproduced structure
objects.E: executor trace including software, parameters, seeds if any, environment, and output digest

checks: locator_check(R) verifies that the claimed source object exists at a stable row/page reference
identity_check(H, M) verifies the reproduced structure is the same object under the declared canonicalization
pair_check(P, n) verifies that N_pair equals the enumerated admissible pairs under the cutoff policy
sum_check(P, S) verifies the raw overlap sum is computed over exactly the admitted pair list
normalization_check(S, Z, value) verifies value = Z(S, n, declared constants)
trace_check(E) verifies that the executor produced the declared intermediate and final digests

reported_context.allowed_claim: This scalar or qualitative overlap/effective-mass statement was reported by the source.

bounded_reproduction_attempt.allowed_claim: A reproduction attempt was run under a declared structure and pair policy.
bounded_reproduction_attempt.forbidden_claim: The attempt establishes source exactness without S and Z.

exact_certified.allowed_claim: The exact O_s observable identity is certified under the declared contract.
exact_certified.forbidden_claim: The certified value is independent of provenance.

current_admission.reason: Missing source row/page, structure identity/hash, pair cutoff/list, N_pair, raw overlap sum, normalization formula/code, same-structure mapping, and executor trace.
current_admission.positive_permission: Srivastava 2019 may remain a reported orbital-overlap/effective-mass context source.

testable_predictions.prediction: When future candidates are reclassified by proof obligations, at least one previously stated exact-looking O_s claim will demote to reported_context because it lacks either pair list/N_pair or normalization code.
testable_predictions.test: Run the CSV modes as an admission checklist on each candidate claim.

testable_predictions.prediction: Two runs with the same scalar O_s but different pair cutoff policies will be treated as distinct observable identities and will fail equality at identity_check or pair_check.
testable_predictions.test: Hash canonical structure and pair policy separately, then compare full observable tuples rather than scalar values.

testable_predictions.prediction: Adding only a better electronic-structure code or a better material model will not change BLOCK status unless it also adds the missing proof objects.
testable_predictions.test: Attempt state transition using executor quality evidence alone; expected result is no transition to exact_certified.

claims.statement: Exact O_s reproduction is an admissibility claim over a proof-carrying observable tuple, not a numerical comparison of a reported scalar.
equations: O_s = (v, R, H, P, n, S, Z, M, E)
exact_certified(O_s) := locator_check(R) and identity_check(H,M) and pair_check(P,n) and sum_check(P,S) and normalization_check(S,Z,v) and trace_check(E)
assumptions: The target observable is intended to be reproducible under a declared finite computation.
The source claim can be represented by stable provenance locators or is otherwise blocked.

claims.statement: The current baseline must admit Srivastava 2019 only as reported orbital-overlap/effective-mass context, because the proof objects needed for exact O_s identity are absent.
equations: proof_objects_current subset {reported_context}; proof_objects_current not superset required(exact_certified)
assumptions: No hidden row/page, structure hash, pair list, raw sum, normalizer, mapping, or trace has been supplied in the PI summary.

claims.statement: A finite-state admission contract prevents category errors: context, attempted reproduction, and exact certification become separate machine states with non-overlapping pass conditions.
equations: S_i -> S_j is legal only if missing(required(S_j)) = empty
assumptions: The project accepts proof obligations as contract gates rather than informal narrative gates.

deepening_1.question: Does the cross-domain isomorphism have a deeper mathematical structure?

layer_1.structure: artifact identity is a dependent pair
layer_1.mapping: The scalar v depends on provenance p; an O_s claim has type Sigma(p:Provenance). Value(p). Erasing p changes the type of the claim.
layer_1.consequence: A bare scalar is a lossy projection and cannot carry exactness.

layer_2.structure: admission is proof search over a finite contract automaton
layer_2.mapping: Each proof object eliminates one missing premise in the admissibility predicate. BLOCK is not failure of physics; it is failure to inhabit the certified state.
layer_2.consequence: The mathematically sharp object is the witness set required to inhabit exact_certified(O_s).

deepening_2.question: Does the borrowed structure have a next-layer extension in its original discipline?

layer_1.source_extension: reproducible builds distinguish bit-identical outputs from provenance-verifiable outputs
layer_1.mapping: O_s exactness should distinguish scalar-equal output from provenance-identical observable output.
layer_1.consequence: Even a matching number remains non-certified if the build/execution chain is not bound.

layer_2.source_extension: zero-knowledge/proof-carrying compilation separates public artifact identity from checkable private execution details
layer_2.mapping: A future O_s baseline could expose digests and proof certificates without publishing every raw implementation detail, provided the verifier can check the declared relation.
layer_2.consequence: The project can demand proof-carrying observables without requiring premature material validation or impossible disclosure standards.

forbidden_claims: Exact O_s is impossible in principle.
A graph descriptor can replace overlap provenance for exact O_s.
Graph-vs-overlap residual regression is relevant to this round's claim.
A material is validated by this proof-carrying contract.
Numeric closeness of a reproduced scalar certifies observable identity.
Executor quality alone can upgrade a claim to exact certification without source locator, structure hash, pair list, raw sum, normalization, mapping, and trace.
